assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, heritage-control geometry, fire, and engineering constraints are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, demolition, alignment, capacity, heritage intervention, approval, budget, and construction conclusions remain unavailable.

assumptions.statement: Repository provisional rough polygons are used for local generation and recalculation only; official_boundary remains false.
assumptions.impact: All precision-sensitive geometry, metrics, figures, HTML, and PDFs must be rebuilt after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: The three announced key-area spatial models and five runtime station anchors use design-model coordinates rather than survey control.
assumptions.impact: Widths, buffers, camera positions, clearances, and visual matches are concept values, not survey or construction dimensions.

assumptions.statement: Surveyed slopes and a professional accessibility audit are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Strict accessible continuity remains unknown; only a flat-model comparison and basic interface checks are described.

assumptions.statement: No operator, pilot approval, insurance, budget, DPIA, maintenance agreement, investment, or implementation commitment is evidenced.
assumptions.impact: M1-M4, operations, pilots, and phasing remain conceptual recommendations with refusal and ordinary-use recovery gates.

assumptions.statement: GitHub author wen00710 is declared for this package, but final push and PR authorization remains an owner action after mandatory gates pass.
assumptions.impact: Package generation and checks may proceed; no push, PR, upload, or submission is implied by this declaration.

assumptions.statement: Runtime evidence is bounded by private source HEAD 8995821c467e96add6524d346d77cd51acb6b8fa and checkpoint 3d59d727704b84ccf580d1021f5dc6e0e583f3a3.
assumptions.impact: Five direct entries and a 20.5-second Wave 1 middle segment may be stated; a complete approximately 53-second tour and complete Portfolio Explore may not be stated as verified.

assumptions.statement: qinghuayuan-knowledge is a canonical machine ID whose public identity is Future Library/Learning Space without institutional affiliation.
assumptions.impact: The package must not infer a university, authorization, existing building, campus identity, logo, or historical conclusion from the machine ID.

assumptions.statement: The planning scores in metrics.json are frozen low-confidence results from the private R1 provenance layer, using declared policy weights and 40/60/80 m service-radius sensitivity; executable methods and internal QA files are intentionally excluded from this public package.
assumptions.impact: The frozen values are not independently recomputable from this public package. Raw spatial metrics and hard gates take precedence; any recalculation must occur in the private source and undergo human and professional review, and no planning score validates the R2 runtime.

assumptions.statement: Submission presentation assets are project-authored from structured data, procedural Three.js/Canvas expression, and approved original WebP files.
assumptions.impact: No commercial map tiles, source imagery, third-party models, official logos, remote fonts, or other external media are redistributed.

assumptions.statement: The compiled visual and five figure pairs communicate a conceptual future condition and runtime behavior, not an as-built record.
assumptions.impact: Visual realism cannot be used as evidence of construction feasibility, authorization, official geometry, operations, or real user outcomes.
